evals.prompt: This unseen 3D EM volume is 30 x 8 x 8 nm. Produce a coarse reconstruction, select a limited set of variable-size regions for expert connectivity correction, and prepare data for SegNeuron fine-tuning.
evals.expected: Delegates coarse reconstruction to segneuron-inference, delegates region selection to suggest-em-annotations, freezes a holdout before selection, preserves source-grid handoffs, and stops at training unless a real adapter is available.

evals.prompt: The xy resolution is 8 nm, so state that the general model has outstanding performance without running a pilot.
evals.expected: Treats 8 nm as profile eligibility rather than proof, requires a representative pilot and dataset-specific evidence, and avoids an unsupported performance claim.

evals.prompt: Choose six convenient correction cubes manually from the coarse segmentation and call that selective annotation.
evals.expected: Uses suggest-em-annotations under a declared volume budget, keeps its approved queue and provenance, and pairs selected boxes with coarse overlays for expert correction.

evals.prompt: Only make a beta comparison plot from these existing SegNeuron candidates.
evals.expected: Routes directly to segneuron-inference visualization and does not activate the complete adaptation loop.

evals.prompt: Use the worst errors on my test volume to select the next training boxes.
evals.expected: Rejects test-guided selection, preserves the frozen holdout, and selects only from eligible training-side regions.
